items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: Louis Nelson used to get full, you know, and I'd high him and fire him and high him and fire him. ... that's the way I carried my band all the time

ctx.x: I never knew he'd die. What about you?
Louis Nelson was the only one that Louis Nelson could play very good trombone when he didn't drink. Yeah, that's right.
